Please remember that when I was translating, I used my academic skills and worked hard to make every word and sentence meet the strictest academic requirements.

en: Hui Shi still didn't understand, so he said to Zhuangzi: "I have a big tree, which others call it acanthus. The trunk is bloated and does not fit the rope, and the branches are curled and irregular. It is really useless. It grows by the roadside. The carpenter turned around when he saw it. What you said just now also sounds big and useless. I am afraid everyone will turn around and leave."

Useful! What's the result?"

zh: 庄子继续说，“能不能换一种用法？譬如，把它移栽到无边无际的旷野里，你可以无牵无挂地徘徊在它的身边，可以逍遥自在地躺卧在它的脚下。刀斧砍不到它，什么也害不了它。这样，它确实还是无用，但是却又何必困苦呢？”
en: Zhuangzi continued, "Can you use it in another way? For example, transplant it into the boundless wilderness. You can wander around it without worries, and you can lie at its feet carefree. Knives and axes cannot cut it, and nothing can harm it. In this way, it is indeed useless, but why bother?"

zh: 诸位，我刚才读的就是《逍遥游》，我给它的今译的一部分段落，跳掉了其中有几个比较费解的段落，但大家一听就知道这个庄子，他在《逍遥游》里面在讲什么？他首先把北海的鱼叫鲲，它化成鸟以后，一飞又飞到几千里，能够击水三千里，能够直上云霄九万里。这样飞的样子，他写得很美，在天上看、在地上看都很美。但是，在飞的时候，突然有寒蝉和小鸠，就是小虫和小鸟在地下就笑了，你们这有什么用处？我们也飞上去过，飞上过去，我们飞不动了，就回来，干嘛还要飞九万里呢？
en: Everyone, what I just read was "Xiaoyaoyou". I have skipped some passages in the modern translation of it, and some of the more difficult passages have been skipped. After it turned into a bird, it flew thousands of miles away, hit the water for three thousand miles, and soared into the sky for ninety thousand miles. Even small insects and small birds laughed underground. What's the use of you? We have also flown up and over, and when we can’t fly anymore, we just come back. Why fly 90,000 miles?

zh: 庄子就感叹了，那实在是小小的东西真是不认识何为大了。但是他是说大的时候他就举了宋荣子这样的人，他觉得这个人了不得，举世的赞誉，他不会来劲；举世的非难，他不会沮丧。但是，宋荣子这样的人，包括列子都是这样，他们的轻松愉快已经了不得了，但是他们还需要凭借个东西，比如凭借风，天上飞的，也需要凭借风，如果没有风他们不自由了。
en: Zhuangzi sighed, it was such a small thing that he didn't know how big it was. But what he means is that when he was young, he cited people like Song Rongzi. He felt that this person was great. He would not be motivated by the praise from the world; he would not be depressed by the criticism from the world. However, people like Song Rongzi, including Liezi, are like this. Their relaxation and happiness are already great, but they still need to rely on something, such as relying on the wind. Those who fly in the sky also need to rely on the wind. If there is no wind, they will not be free.

zh: 他所说的“逍遥游”，就是什么也可以不凭借，这是逍遥游的本意。他得出了个结论，至人，至高无上的至，至人，不需要守己，不需要守住自己；神人不需要功绩，功绩就是我依凭的东西；圣人不需要名气，名气也是我所依凭的东西。自己是我依靠的东西，功绩是我依靠的东西，名气是我依靠东西，全部都不依靠了，那么逍遥游的自由就来了。

I am something I rely on, my achievements are something I rely on, and fame is something I rely on. If I no longer rely on any of them, then the freedom of free travel will come.

zh: 他举了尧帝要让位给许由，两个人都非常自由，古代的圣人了，都非常自由地在谈论。然后目标就是说在山上有一个神人，像仙人一样，他样貌是多么纯净，心灵是多么的透彻，那这是我们所追求的目标了，这是也是庄子所追求的目标了。
en: He proposed that Emperor Yao should give way to Xu You. Both of them were very free. They were ancient saints and they both talked very freely. Then the goal is to say that there is a god on the mountain, like an immortal, how pure his appearance is and how thorough his mind is. Then this is the goal we pursue, and this is also the goal pursued by Zhuangzi.

He feels that you let this useless tree grow there, and you lie at your feet freely and look at it as if it is useless, but why bother?
